description: Source code for a Compose UI component that renders different types of content cards for Android TV, including a default poster variant and a TV channel variant. Implements interactive UI elements, styling, and layout logic.

classes.name: HomeCardVariant
classes.description: Enum defining variants of the HomeCard, either Default or TvChannel.

methods.name: HomeCard
methods.description: Main composable function that displays either a Default poster or TV channel card based on variant.

methods.name: DefaultPosterCard
methods.description: Private composable rendering the default poster variant of the card with poster image, progress bar, and title.

methods.name: TvChannelCard
methods.description: Private composable rendering the TV channel card variant with poster, info labels, live badge, progress, and channel icon.
